name: hcapp_getMyEmailStatus
description: The signed-in hasher's OWN email delivery status (E19.F4), so the app can ask for a new address when the current one is bouncing. Deliberately not part of the hashers sync rowset — that would push everybody's status to every phone. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 152, @param NULL); no permission gate, the caller reads only their own HC.Hasher row.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

rowsets.description: On auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): the error detail alone, no envelope. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (THROW).

rowsets.name: EmailStatus
rowsets.description: Exactly one row for the caller (zero only if the Hasher row has gone).

columns.name: email
columns.description: HC.Hasher.Email. May be a generated address (HC6.IsGeneratedEmail) — shown dark red and never sent to.

columns.name: emailStatusChangedAt
columns.description: HC.Hasher.EmailStatusChangedAt — when the status last changed; NULL if never.

columns.name: emailBlocked
columns.description: HC.Hasher.EmailBlocked: 1 when the hasher has blocked all email from Harrier Central.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog from the CATCH block (lines 44-45, after ROLLBACK)
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
